scope: User-directed current-history exploration, 2016 through the latest completed session this week. No strategy backtests or parameter selection.
source_policy: Free public daily ETF snapshot. Exploratory proxy; does not replace specified point-in-time corporate-action data.
checks: Coverage versus historical NYSE session calendar, including exceptional closures and half days.
Dates sorted and unique; OHLCV/adjusted-close missingness; finite and positive prices; nonnegative and zero volume; OHLC consistency.
Timestamp conversion in America/New_York; daily bars do not establish release time or auction executability.
Distribution of unfilled adjusted-close simple returns, volatility, skewness, excess kurtosis, quantiles and empirical tail frequency.
Flag absolute daily returns above 10%, robust median/MAD scores above 8 and intraday range above 15%; retain observations, no winsorization.
Log suspicious date gaps, flat-price runs, volume spikes and corporate-action events.
Same-session Pearson and Spearman daily-return correlations, annual correlation stability and 63-session rolling correlations.
Descriptive within-instrument lagged-return correlations at lags 1, 5 and 21; no prediction claim or tuning.
Compare unadjusted/split-adjusted close returns with adjusted-close returns around reported dividend/split events when provided.
Estimate return/volume relationships within each ETF using lagged 20-session median volume; treat them as descriptive.
Inspect public raw responses and provider metadata; record provenance, hashes and unresolved licensing/point-in-time limitations.
gates: Reject rows outside authorized date range; no forward filling of prices or returns.
Report non-session bars or absent expected sessions before computing matched-session relationships.
Flag rather than delete valid market extremes; unresolved structural defects block formal backtesting.
No strategy weights, portfolio P&L, strategy Sharpe or threshold search. Historical asset statistics through the authorized current cutoff are permitted.
Preserve original research rules and rejection criteria regardless of EDA findings.
amendment: User replaced the 2006–2015-only analysis with a current horizon. Previous historical validation/holdout periods are exploratory and are not untouched confirmatory data. Keep economic strategy rules and thresholds unchanged.
